blueprint_coverage: The generated baseline profile includes Blueprint types already loaded at the title screen; unloaded types are not included in its descriptor count. Story additionally uses exact-build decoded minimap bindings and live reflected fields, requiring the expected class, field size and verified native offsets before reading. The Blueprint VM_MiniMap reference is resolved by name and checked against its bound native view model.
story_authority: Current game-instance main QuestData, condition-filtered DestinationList and native active-area quest relations. Exact audited opening main-story continuations can be listed when their current native condition and player-overlap collision are enabled. Camera, occlusion and prior sight do not gate supported active loaded-area targets. Raw unfiltered ScenarioSubsystem lists and map Vector2D coordinates are never route authority.
